create_pipeline_rag: create a Llama Index RAG pipeline that loads documents from a local data directory into a vector store index
build_query_engine_rag: build a streaming query engine from a Llama Index VectorStoreIndex to answer questions over loaded documents
run_rag_query: run a RAG query against the Llama Index pipeline with a user message to retrieve relevant information from the knowledge base
test_pipeline_startup: test the Pipeline.on_startup method to initialize documents and vector store index from a local data directory
review_pipeline_pipe: review the Pipeline.pipe method that accepts user messages and returns a streaming response from the RAG query engine
